sources.note: Main website. Nextech serves 16,000+ practices across dermatology, ophthalmology, plastic surgery, orthopedics, and med spa. Offers cloud-based EHR, PM, RCM, AI, analytics, TouchMD, and CRM.
ONC compliance page with links to mandatory disclosures PDFs, real world test plans/results, and certification certificates for Nextech Select/NexCloud v20.

Dermatology product page. Describes customizable templates, e-prescribing, photo management, lead tracking, scheduling, patient intake, inventory management, membership management, patient portal, analytics.

Ophthalmology product page. Describes single-page EHR, comorbidity tracking, real-time quality measures, scheduling, patient portal, lead management, payment processing, retail optical shop integration, IRIS Registry collaboration, shared care network.

Plastic surgery product page. Describes customizable charting, photo management with markups, mobile apps, e-prescribing, lead management, ASC billing, memberships, POS, inventory management, marketing automation.

Ophthalmology EHR system details. Describes configurable charting, subspecialty flowsheets (glaucoma, cataract), layered drawings, MIPS monitoring, referral management, EPCS, automatic letter generation, ASC charting, telemedicine.
Plastic surgery PM features. Details scheduling, insurance and cosmetic billing, claims scrubbing, RCM, integrated payments, inventory management, analytics dashboards.
Advanced Analytics product page. Pre-built KPIs, customizable dashboards, revenue trends, appointment volume, ICD-10 patterns, patient procedure compliance monitoring, real-time alerts.

Partner integrations page. Lists TriZetto (billing), Assembly Health (RCM), DrFirst/NewCrop (e-prescribing), Nuance (speech recognition), Topcon Harmony (ophthalmology imaging), IBRA (cataract surgery planning), Ocuco (optical), Zocdoc, NextPatient, Clearwave (scheduling), DermPRO (e-commerce), CareCredit (financing), and many more.

July 2016 press release announcing NexCloud launch. Cloud-based PM & EMR with monthly subscription pricing, rapid implementation, anytime/anywhere access. Confirmed as cloud version of existing Nextech platform.
TPG acquisition announcement (2023). $1.4B acquisition from Thomas H. Lee Partners. Notes 11,000+ physicians and 60,000+ clinics served.
Healthcare Dive reporting on TPG's $1.4B acquisition of Nextech. Confirms company history: Francisco Partners → Thomas H. Lee Partners (2019, ~$500M) → TPG (2023, $1.4B).
2014 acquisition of MDIntelleSys (IntelleChartPRO), the leading cloud-based EHR for eye care. Doubled Nextech's ophthalmology market share.
Nextech named 2024 Best in KLAS: Ambulatory Specialty EHR.
Nextech wins 2026 Best in KLAS for Ambulatory Ophthalmology Solutions.

Software Finder review. Lists features: specialty-specific templates, scheduling, billing with automatic coding, claims submission, insurance eligibility, analytics, referral management, imaging integration. Serves orthopedics, plastic surgery, med spa, dermatology, ophthalmology, optometry.

Capterra listing. 4.0/5 stars from 213 reviews. Users praise ease of use and navigation but note limited form customization and reporting. Confirms integrated scheduling, billing, charting, e-prescribing, image management.
SelectHub comparison page noting Nextech's specialty focus and feature set.
